description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation value across different layers for various components of a baseline model. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 22, and is marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value", also has a linear scale, spans from 0 to 1600, and is marked at intervals of 200. The plot displays four lines representing different components: "attn_output" (blue, dashed), "attn_residual" (orange, dotted), "ffn_output" (green, dash-dotted), and "ffn_residual" (red, solid). The "attn_output" line remains relatively stable around 50, with a slight increase to approximately 100 at layer 21. The "attn_residual" line starts at 0, surges to around 1400 at layer 5, and then drops to 0 at layer 17 before rising again to approximately 1500 at layer 21 and then falling to around 200 at layer 22. The "ffn_output" line begins at 0, peaks at about 200 at layer 5, dips to 0 between layers 6 and 16, and then rises to around 1400 at layer 17 before dropping to 0 at layer 21 and rising again to approximately 600 at layer 22. The "ffn_residual" line starts at 0, jumps to around 1500 at layer 5, remains relatively stable until layer 18, and then gradually decreases to approximately 1400 at layer 22.
